data.narrative:
Precision AI is a Series A-stage autonomous systems company operating within the Drones & Autonomous sector. The competitive landscape includes eight private peers (Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, and others) and no direct public comparables. The narrowness of same-stage and valuation-tier peers within this sector limits reliance on peer multiples.

Stage-progression analysis forms the primary valuation method. Using the $20M in total capital raised as a proxy for pre-money value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $40M. This method is applicable given the company's clear Series A positioning and the availability of fundraising history.

Peer-median methodology is not applicable here. Although seven same-sector companies exist, insufficient granularity within same-stage and valuation-tier subsets (zero same-stage, one adjacent-stage datapoint identified) prevents reliable median benchmarking without introducing material bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $34M to $46M, with a median of $40M. The low-to-high range reflects inherent uncertainty in stage-progression calibration absent corroborating peer data. Key sensitivities include the accuracy of the 2.0x multiplier for this subsector and the absence of revenue or unit economics data to validate growth assumptions underlying the step-up. Acquisition of additional peer comps or performance metrics would narrow this band materially.
